en: The image shows the reverse side of an old postcard or postal card with handwritten German text in black ink. The card has a small round hole punched near the top edge and printed text along the bottom margin. The handwriting is cursive and fills most of the card. At the top right there is a place and date written, starting with "Leipzig" followed by a date in 1918. The card is displayed against a dark background.
